MK: Communicates adequate understanding of available information
SBP: Obtains adequate medical information for death certificate
ICS: Introductions and demeanor establish a therapeutic connection appropriate to the situation
Sits down and focuses on the appropriate next of kin or DPOA-HC
Avoids medical jargon or euphemisms for “died” or “dead
Speaks to a lack of suffering
Offers family to view body appropriately
Offers final condolences to family and contact information
PBLI: Requests feedback on personal performance, and engages staff/colleagues in case-appropriate reflection
